ops.old: Cut 500g flathead into bite-sized pieces and dust in flour mixed with smoked paprika and salt. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp. Drain on paper and serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce, like a meal on the deck of a trawler.
ops.new: Cut 500g cod into bite-sized pieces and dust in flour mixed with smoked paprika and salt. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp. Drain on paper and serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce, like a meal on the deck of a trawler.

ops.old: Cut the flathead into pieces up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled. Best dusted and fried just before serving
ops.new: Cut the cod into pieces up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled. Best dusted and fried just before serving

ops.old: Flathead pieces dusted in flour and paprika, fried at 180C until crisp, with lemon and tartare sauce.
ops.new: Cod pieces dusted in flour and paprika, fried at 180C until crisp, with lemon and tartare sauce.
